figures.caption: Fig. 1. Per-category faithfulness on the development set. Top: single-shot direct mode — GPT-5.4’s deficit concentrates in mixed (FunctionalProperty closure + disjointness) and numeric builtin. Bottom: after counterexampledriven repair — GPT-5.4 closes most of the gap; residual errors concentrate in the mixed category.

Fig. 2. Rounds-until-correct per model on the development set under counterexample repair (max 3 rounds). GPT-5.4 requires more rounds than the other three models; the “never” bar marks queries still wrong after the three-round budget.

Fig. 3. Direct-mode error taxonomy on the development set. GPT-5.4’s errors are dominated by overcautious (“unknown” where the reasoner says “no”); Minimax’s errors are dominated by malformed JSON (a reasoning-model token-budget artefact rather than a semantic error).
